plugin.name: Users
plugin.description: Manage the user accounts, groups, passwords and SSH keys on your hosts.

use.title: Use Users
use.description: See accounts on hosts you can reach, and change them on hosts you can edit.

enable.label: Users
enable.description: Manage user accounts and groups on this host from the Users tab.

useSudo.label: Use sudo
useSudo.description: Use sudo to read and change accounts. Turn off if the login is root.

readOnly.label: Read only
readOnly.description: Show accounts but never change them on this host.

tab.title: Users
tab.error: Could not load the accounts from this host.
tab.disabled: Users is turned off for this host. Turn it on in the host settings.
tab.sudo: Changes and password states need a root login, passwordless sudo or a saved Sudo Password on this host.
tab.noTools: useradd is not installed on this host. On Alpine, install the shadow package.

detail.groupsPlaceholder: Type a group and press Enter
detail.loadFailed: Could not read this user's keys and last login.
detail.newPasswordHint: Sent to the host over SSH and set with chpasswd. It is never stored in Termix.
detail.expirePassword: Ask for a new one at next login
detail.expired: They will pick a new password at the next login.
detail.sudoHint: Run commands as root through the {{group}} group.
detail.sudoProtected: You can't take sudo from root or the user Termix logs in as.
detail.sudoDesc: Adds them to the {{group}} group, so they can run any command as root.
detail.lockDesc: They can't log in with a password or an SSH key until you unlock the account.
detail.lockHint: Blocks password and SSH key logins.
detail.protected: Root and the user Termix logs in as can't be locked or deleted.
detail.deleteDesc: The account is removed. Its home folder stays on the host.
detail.deleteDescHome: The account and {{home}} are removed. This can't be undone.

keys.title: SSH keys
keys.denied: The keys can't be read without root.
keys.addHint: Paste one public key, like the contents of id_ed25519.pub.

create.title: New user
create.name: User name
create.nameInvalid: Start with a letter and use only a-z, 0-9, - and _.
create.passwordHint: Optional. Without one the user can only log in with an SSH key.

groups.name: Group name
groups.mainGroupHint: This is their main group, so they always belong to it.
groups.deleteDesc: The group is removed. Files it owned keep its old id.

manager.title: Users
manager.disabled: Turn on Users for this host in its settings to see its accounts here.
